title: The Missing Layer in Agentic AI — Giedrius Šteimantas, Oxylabs
talk_summary: A web-scraping vendor argues that agent pipelines should avoid browsers except when strictly necessary, validate fetched content before spending LLM tokens on it, and use lightweight JSON/markdown APIs for discovery and verification. The concrete mechanism is fail-loudly content validation plus cheap structured retrieval, with a browser reserved for the final interactive step.

takeaways.technique: Validate content before feeding the LLM
takeaways.what_they_do: They check that fetched content is actually valid (not a captcha/block page) before sending it to the model, so invalid results are dropped rather than tokenized.
takeaways.evidence_quote: We need to make sure that the content is valid before even attempting any compression.
takeaways.numbers: Claims 70% of tokens wasted when 3 of 10 sites return valid content but all 10 are fed to the model

takeaways.technique: Prefer lightweight structured APIs over browser automation
takeaways.what_they_do: For discovery they use a search API returning compact JSON (<2000 tokens, <700ms) instead of driving a browser; browser is reserved for the final interactive purchase step.
Their scraper API returns an explicit error on captcha/block instead of a 200 with junk, and only charges for successful results, making cost per transaction predictable.
takeaways.evidence_quote: If the scraper fails, there's no cost and it fails loudly.

takeaways.technique: Markdown/compact rendering instead of raw HTML
takeaways.what_they_do: They request markdown from the fetch API so raw HTML is never submitted to the LLM.
takeaways.evidence_quote: The API supports markdown. So, no need to submit raw HTML to LLMs.

takeaways.what_they_do: They split the workflow into discovery (cheap search, small model), decision (validated fetch), and execution (full browser + LLM), using the heavy tool only where required.
takeaways.evidence_quote: Since the responses are quite small and there is no need for complicated models, we can have the agent run quite quickly in this stage.
